## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior or learning improvement. Link the issue when there is one.

## Changes

- Keep the scope focused and explain meaningful tradeoffs.

## Validation

- List exact commands and results; explicitly state skipped checks and why.
- For UI changes, include native wide/compact and keyboard review with fictional data.
- For content changes, include the affected lesson/exam IDs and positive, negative and alternative verification.

## Compatibility and rollout

Describe any effect on saved data, grading, runtime safety, releases or external tools. State whether a migration is needed. Remove this placeholder text before submitting; do not include secrets or real learner data.
